name: Jutze Intelligence Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Jutze Intelligence Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of intelligent equipment and components in China and internationally. It offers machine vision equipment, control cable assemblies, and control units and related equipment. The company's products are used in electronic information manufacturing, industrial control, metallurgy, electronics, new energy, food and packaging, and automobiles industries. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
